cohort: The study included 79 women with structural heart disease experiencing 103 pregnancies, who received obstetric care at Sejong General Hospital between January 2007 and December 2016.
finding: Overall complications associated with pregnancy in women with structural heart disease were very high at 28.16%.
mod_finding: Among 77 deliveries, 71.43% (55 patients) delivered by cesarean section, with 16 of these performed due to maternal hemodynamic risk.
